API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesGet Network Service Groups
Get Network Service Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/networkServiceGroups

Retrieves the list of network service groups. To learn more, see About Network Service Groups.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against the network service group parameters.

Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

ID of the network service group.

name
string

Name of the network service group.

services
object[]
description
string

Description of the network service group.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the network service group is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

]
